_note: Times are seconds on the shared 110s arena clock (Cycle/Encounters), so every player sees each beat once per round. 'reuses' names the existing system to adapt. All numbers are hypotheses.

roundBeats.name: GRAZE
roundBeats.intent: calm pods at habitats; warm up loops and chain

roundBeats.name: GATHER
roundBeats.intent: arena signature event at t=30 creates the first big-loop opportunity

roundBeats.name: STAMPEDE
roundBeats.intent: the title moment: net a charging herd

roundBeats.name: GOLDEN FINALE
roundBeats.intent: one Golden Runaway, all loops x1.5, bank before the buzzer

events.rule: A herd of N arena-native creatures (N = 12 + 2 per player, max 18) enters at the first point of one of the arena's two stampede routes (alternating each cycle) and charges along it at 26 in a column 3 wide, 2.5 studs apart. They ignore players but swerve up to 4 studs around a body in their path. Any closed loop catches those inside as normal. Survivors exit at the route end and despawn.
events.telegraph: t=49: ground rumble + dust plume at the entry + the whole route drawn as marching chevrons; a horn at t=53; lead animal appears at t=55
events.fairness: route never crosses a bank ring or spawn; column cannot be body-blocked; each player's catches are their own, so there is nothing to steal
events.multiplayer: two players looping opposite ends both score; a loop that contains 8+ shows STAMPEDE! to the whole arena
events.reward: normal loop scoring (size multiplier makes this the highest-value 14 seconds of the round)
events.skill: pre-lay an open horseshoe across the route and SNAP it closed as the column fills it; late loops only catch stragglers

events.rule: One of the three bloom buds (rotating a,b,c by cycle index) swells for 5s then opens: 5 Pips and 3 Cublooms tumble out and feed in a 7-stud cluster at its base for 6s (they ignore players while feeding unless a player comes inside 5 studs), then scatter outward at flee speed.
events.telegraph: bud pulses and a rising three-note chime repeats; petals crack open at t=29
events.fairness: event creatures are extra (above base cap) and visible to all; scatter direction is away from the nearest player, so arriving late still gives a herding chance
events.multiplayer: 8 creatures is one ROUNDUP for a solo player or a race/assist for several; pushing them (spook credit) earns ASSIST
events.reward: normal loop scoring; a loop of all 8 awards the FULL BLOOM style bonus +40
events.skill: approach wide (outside 5 studs) and ring the whole cluster; rushing in scatters it

events.rule: Three of the five geysers (seeded by cycle index) erupt 4s apart. Each eruption launches every creature within 9 studs; they land together in a 5-stud cluster 10 studs downhill and are DAZED 3s (still, spinning, catchable). A player on an erupting geyser is launched 34 studs up and can steer the fall (no damage).
events.telegraph: geyser cap rattles and bubbles 3s before; a ring on the ground shows the 9-stud launch radius
events.fairness: dazed creatures are catchable by anyone; launch has no downside for players
events.multiplayer: one player herds toward a geyser while another waits at the landing spot
events.reward: normal loop scoring; catching dazed creatures adds the existing STARSTRUCK tag renamed FIZZED (+10 each)
events.skill: herd a pod (or bowl a Sunshell) into the ring before it blows, then loop the landing cluster

events.reuses: Encounters.starfall + Main.stepStarfall (keep choreography, swap impact points to arena eventAnchors)
events.rule: Six stars land one every 2.5s at the eventAnchors in seeded order. Creatures within 8 studs of an impact are DAZED 3s. An impact leaves a glowing crater rim (r=6) for 10s that acts as a temporary pinch wall. Players are never hit (impact pushes a player 6 studs outward, no penalty).
events.telegraph: 2.0s shrinking ring + a light shaft from the sky; the observatory roof slit points at the next impact
events.fairness: identical for everyone in the arena
events.multiplayer: shared spectacle; assists for herding creatures into a ring
events.reward: STARSTRUCK tag (+10 each) on dazed catches (existing)
events.skill: herd creatures into the telegraph ring, or pinch against the crater rim

events.reuses: golden finale (Main spawn at 85s, World.gild, creditAssist)
events.rule: One golden variant of a seeded arena species spawns at the habitat farthest from all players. It needs wraps = species wraps + 1 (minimum 2); wrap progress is shared and lasts 8s. EVERY player who contributed a wrap receives the catch: full value x3, Gilded album credit, GOLDEN tag. All loops score x1.5 during the finale.
events.telegraph: t=82 golden light beam at the spawn habitat + compass chevron on the HUD edge
events.fairness: no last-hit stealing: contribution = reward. Solo needs 2 loops.
events.multiplayer: arena-wide toast names everyone who wrapped it
events.reward: value x3, Gilded album mark (existing), podium Golden Catcher (existing)
events.skill: it flees at x1.35; use pinch walls and SNAP

events.rule: On every 4th arena cycle (cycleIndex % 4 == 3), and additionally on any cycle in which a present player is in their 3rd-ever round and has never met a Legend, the arena's Legend (creatures.json legends) walks its legend route for 40s. Wraps are shared across players. On the final wrap every contributor gets: Legend album stamp (new profile field), +60 x their wrap share (minimum 50% of full value) and a cosmetic Legend Token (1 per catch; 3 tokens buy that Legend's trail).
events.telegraph: t=58: sky dims slightly in the arena palette, a deep horn, the route glows; the Legend rises at t=68
events.fairness: contribution based, minimum share floor, failure costs nothing; Legends are never purchasable or randomly withheld (deterministic schedule shown on the arena records board as 'Legend in N rounds')
events.multiplayer: the designed co-op spectacle: four players can finish it in one pass each
events.skill: large clean loops under time pressure; each Legend tests its arena's twist
